name: Resonance reduces Hasten's cooldown from Artificer's Wand or Crystal Cannon (#741)
contract: Resonance 706079 applies aura 42 (proc trigger spell) on 570084 (a SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_MODIFY_COOLDOWN effect that reduces Hasten 801304's cooldown by 1000ms), but Spell.dbc gives it ProcFlags 0 and no spell_proc row existed, so it never procced. With a spell_proc row gated on the ranged class damage of Artificer's Wand or Crystal Cannon (35% chance), Hasten's 90s cooldown drops by 1000ms per proc. Hasten's cooldown is large enough (90s) that a handful of near-instant Crystal Cannon casts cannot explain a >=1000ms drop through natural decay alone.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
At least one of 3 Crystal Cannon hits (35% chance each) reduces Hasten's cooldown by at least 1s
